desc.zh: 一个事件越不可能，发生时带来的信息越大：惊奇度 I = −log₂p，概率每减半恰好 +1 bit。熵是平均惊奇——二元熵曲线在公平的 p = ½ 登顶 1 bit；符号源沿时间轴流出惊奇脉冲，运行平均线逐渐贴上 H 线。最后逐步重演 Huffman 建树：高频短码、低频长码，平均码长永远压不到熵线之下——熵是无损压缩的极限。
desc.en: The less likely an event, the more information it carries: surprise I = −log₂p, exactly +1 bit per halving of p. Entropy is average surprise — the binary entropy curve peaks at 1 bit at the fair p = ½; a symbol source streams surprise pulses while the running average settles onto the H line. Then replay Huffman construction step by step: short codes for frequent symbols, long for rare ones, and the mean code length never drops below the entropy line — entropy is the limit of lossless compression.

title.zh: 霍夫曼编码 · 从文本到比特
title.en: Huffman Coding · From Text to Bits

desc.zh: 输入任意一段文字，看它一步步变成比特流。编码器读不懂含义，它只数数：字符沿时间轴流走，只剩下一排频次柱。接着每一拍合并两个最小权重的节点，树自底向上长出来——越罕见的字符越早被合并，在树里沉得越深；高频字符挂得浅，码字就短。最后逐字编码，码流像示波器上的方波流出，每个字符占据的宽度就是它的代价。关掉码字分组，所有分隔标记消失，解码行依然一字不差——这就是前缀码的精髓：没有任何码字是另一个码字的前缀。速度可调、可暂停，每一步合并与每一个码字都在面板里逐条列出。
desc.en: Type any text and watch it turn into bits, one step at a time. The encoder never reads meaning — it only counts: characters stream away along the time axis and all that remains is a row of frequency bars. Then each tick merges the two lightest nodes and the tree grows bottom-up — the rarer a character, the earlier it merges and the deeper it sinks, while frequent ones hang shallow and get short codewords. Finally the text is encoded character by character, the bitstream unrolling like a square wave where the width each character occupies is exactly its cost. Switch off the codeword groups and every separator vanishes, yet the decoded row still recovers the text exactly — that is the heart of a prefix code: no codeword is a prefix of another. Speed is adjustable, playback pauses, and every merge and every codeword is logged in the panel.

title.zh: 维度的阶梯 · 从点到分形
title.en: The Ladder of Dimension · From a Point to Fractals

desc.zh: 把一个东西放大 r 倍，需要 N 份原件才填得满它——维数就定义为 d = log N / log r。点是 0、线是 1、方是 2、立方是 3，而 Cantor 集是 0.631、Koch 曲线是 1.262、Sierpiński 三角是 1.585：切到 log-log 侧视，七条射线扇形张开，非整数的斜率明明白白夹在整数之间，分形不再是怪东西，只是斜率不凑整。维数还可以量出来：用边长 ε 的盒子覆盖曲线数格子，ε 缩小一半时格子数翻多少倍，log-log 上的斜率就是多少——圆给出 1、圆盘给出 2、Koch 给出 1.23，测法自证可信。再往深一层，豪斯多夫测度回答了这个指数为什么非它不可：Σ(diam)^d 在临界维数处从 ∞ 一步跌到 0，而允许大小不一的覆盖取下确界，正是它与只用同尺寸盒子的闵可夫斯基维数的分别。最后一页把同一个公式推到第四维：超立方体的「立方体套立方体」不是套着的，那只是四维在三维里投下的影子。
desc.en: Scale a thing by r and it takes N copies to fill it again — that is the definition: d = log N / log r. A point gives 0, a line 1, a square 2, a cube 3 — and the Cantor set gives 0.631, the Koch curve 1.262, the Sierpiński triangle 1.585. Switch to the log-log side view and seven rays fan out, the non-integer slopes visibly wedged between the integer ones: a fractal is not a strange object, only a slope that does not land on a whole number. Dimension can also be measured rather than derived: cover a curve with boxes of side ε and count them, and the factor by which the count grows as ε halves is the slope on the log-log plot — a circle gives 1, a disk gives 2, the Koch curve gives 1.23, so the method vouches for itself. One layer deeper, the Hausdorff measure shows why that exponent is forced: Σ(diam)^d falls from ∞ to 0 in a single step at the critical dimension, and allowing covers of unequal size and taking the infimum is exactly what separates it from the equal-box Minkowski dimension. The last tab pushes the same formula into the fourth dimension: the tesseract's cube-inside-a-cube is not nested at all — it is the shadow four dimensions cast into three.

title.zh: 光锥 · 四维时空的因果结构
title.en: The Light Cone · Causal Structure of Spacetime

desc.zh: 锥不是画出来的，是一次闪光扫出来的：从原点发出的光在每个时刻是半径 r = ct 的圆，圆一边长大一边沿 ct 上升，扫出的曲面就是光锥——取 c = 1，母线斜率恰好是 1，45° 于是成了结论而不是约定。打开「伽利略速度叠加」对照：按速度叠加，运动观察者的闪光圆心会跟着他跑，锥歪了；而光速对所有人一样意味着圆心钉死在原点，锥纹丝不动，让步的只能是「同时」。由此 (ct)² − r² = 0 对人人成立，推广开就是不变间隔 s² = (ct)² − x² − y²。往下三页把这条线索走完：s² 的符号把时空切成绝对未来、绝对过去与「别处」；三条世界线上的固有时钟点显示闵可夫斯基几何里三角不等式是反的——直的那条最长，折返得越急、回来时钟走得越少；拉动 β，坐标轴与同时面向光锥对称剪切，两个同时的事件分出先后而因果毫发无伤；最后 s² 的等值面是双曲面，推动就是沿双曲线的双曲旋转，光锥则是那条圆心退到无穷远的「圆」。
desc.en: The cone is not drawn — it is swept. Light leaving the origin is a circle of radius r = ct at every instant, and as that circle grows it rises along ct, sweeping out the light cone. With c = 1 the generators have slope exactly 1, so 45° is a conclusion rather than a convention. Switch on the Galilean control: under velocity addition a moving observer's flash circle drifts along with them and the cone tips over, whereas the constancy of c pins the centre at the origin and the cone does not budge — what has to give is simultaneity. Since (ct)² − r² = 0 then holds for everyone, extending it off the cone gives the invariant interval s² = (ct)² − x² − y². Three further tabs follow that thread: the sign of s² cuts spacetime into absolute future, absolute past and elsewhere; proper-time ticks on three worldlines show the triangle inequality running backwards in Minkowski geometry — the straight one is longest, and the sharper the turnaround the less the travelling clock records; dragging β shears the axes and the planes of simultaneity symmetrically toward the cone, splitting two simultaneous events in time while causality is untouched; and finally the level sets of s² are hyperboloids, a boost is a hyperbolic rotation along them, and the light cone is the circle whose centre has receded to infinity.
